description: Brand and collection discovery manifest sourced from public retailer brand indexes. This file intentionally does not invent fragrance identities, product variants, EAN/GTINs, prices, stock, or retailer offers. Individual fragrance records must be harvested from product-level sources and deduplicated before canonical catalog import.

normalization_notes: Treat Maison Alhambra and the user's spelling Alambra as an alias candidate; preserve Maison Alhambra as the display brand unless product evidence establishes a different manufacturer.
Do not merge Games of Spades into another brand without product-level brand ownership evidence.
Treat Velixir and Mykonos as brand/collection names pending individual product verification.
Do not infer that 'all stores sell' a brand from one retailer's collection index.
